Barkada — Social Media App

A small-circle social app for close friends: stories, posts and plans without public follower counts.

THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Big social feeds optimise for strangers and engagement, not for staying close to friends.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

No public counts, a chronological feed and a shared "plans" tab that turns chats into meetups.
